game.name: Mafia II (Europe, Australia)
game.desc: Mafia II is an action game for Xbox 360. The story begins in the 1940s in Empire City, a fictional American city inspired by New York and San Francisco, which three mafia families are fighting over. The player takes on the role of Vito Scaletta, the son of a Sicilian emigrant returning from the war, who is determined to get out of poverty by any means necessary, including crime. The game offers a variety of missions mixing gun fights and car chases. nn
